info.description: Site-wide chrome shown on every page: the header/footer logo, footer tagline/description, social links, contact info, and the footer's Quick Links / Resources / Legal link lists. Publicly readable (find only, auth: false) so the Nuxt frontend can render the header and footer without authentication - see routes/global-settings.ts and bootstrap/permissions-setup.ts's PUBLIC_PERMISSIONS.

logo.description: Brand mark shown in both the header nav and the footer.

contactWebsiteLabel.description: Display text for the website link, e.g. 'www.example.com' (no scheme).

contactWebsiteUrl.description: Actual href for the website link, e.g. 'https://www.example.com'.

copyrightText.description: Full footer copyright line, with a literal '{year}' token the frontend substitutes with the current year at render time, e.g. 'Certrust © {year}. All rights reserved.'
